# Aura of Intelligence for Adaptive Whole of Life Support

> A dated public proposal by Luke Nathan Hayes for personal continuity, meaningful activities and support through changing adult care needs.

The full source is dated 27 October 2026. A working browser prototype and proposed clinical service have distinct development stages. This site is reading material, not onboarding or an operating clinical service. Preserve research, funding and evidence limitations. C-Hours are nonmonetary verified voluntary contributions.
